query: SELECT count(*) AS "all!", count(*) FILTER (WHERE enabled) AS "enabled!", count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT enabled) AS "disabled!" FROM seller_rule WHERE org_id = $1 AND ($2::text IS NULL OR kind = $2) AND ($3::text IS NULL OR source = $3) AND ($4::text IS NULL OR target = $4) AND ($5::text IS NULL OR search_text LIKE $5 ESCAPE '\')
